description: Daily calorie, protein, carbohydrate, fat and fibre targets for someone taking a GLP-1 receptor agonist, plus the appetite ceiling: a dose aware estimate of the most they are likely to manage in a day. Use it for anyone taking or considering one of these medications, where a standard calorie calculation would assume an appetite they do not have. Returns the full derivation with a PubMed citation per step. The engine is the one behind the Foodose iPhone app, which applies it every morning to plate a day of food around the user's dose week. Educational only. Not medical advice, not a diagnosis, and not a substitute for the clinician who prescribes the medication. Not appropriate for pregnancy, breastfeeding, insulin or sulfonylurea use, a history of disordered eating, or anyone under 18.

doseMg.description: Current dose in mg. Must be a licensed dose for that medication, otherwise it is treated as 0. Use get_appetite_ceiling to list the licensed doses.

goalWeightKg.description: Defaults to 85 percent of current weight.

medication.description: Brand name, any case. Generic names map to the weight-management brand: semaglutide to Wegovy, tirzepatide to Zepbound, liraglutide to Saxenda, dulaglutide to Trulicity, oral semaglutide to Rybelsus.

sex.description: Biological sex, which sets the BMR constant.

startWeightKg.description: Weight when the medication was started, used for the adaptive thermogenesis step.
